description: Switch to a different AgentsChat profile at runtime, register a new profile for this window, or disconnect. Lists available profiles and their lock status if no name is given.

conversation_id.description: Optional session/conversation ID to bind to this profile in session-binds.json

disconnect.description: If true, disconnect this window from its current profile and release its lock

profile_name.description: Existing profile name to switch to (omit to list available profiles)

register.description: If true, register profile_name as a new agent when it does not exist

register_name.description: Display name to register a brand-new AgentsChat agent and connect this window to it

name: switch_profile
